description: cosmos: User Posts. GET /v1/cosmos/user/posts. Get the public posts saved to a Cosmos user profile. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when items is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response cursor unchanged. Stop when it is null; sending the literal string "null" returns an empty terminal page without fetching or charging.
